a.sheet_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Racing Tycoon driver equipment icon concept sheet. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES only: the approved bag inventory establishes soft miniature toy forms and the engine/crate sprites establish material and simplification. Create exactly SIX separate equipment icons in a spacious regular 3 columns x 2 rows grid, no dividers, no cards, NO TEXT, no labels, no numbers, no logos. Order top row: Balaclava (soft cloth hood with one eye opening, NOT helmet), Racing Gloves (one pair), Pit Cap (baseball pit cap). Bottom row: Driver Boots (one pair of ankle racing boots), Stopwatch (round analog watch with top button and simple ticks, no numerals), Carbon Helmet (full face motorsport helmet, closed dark visor, subtle broad carbon panels, no tiny weave). All six same visual mass, fit within identical square cells, fully visible, generous transparent gutters. Consistent slightly elevated front three-quarter view facing left, orthographic miniature camera, top-left lighting. Silhouettes immediately distinguishable at approximately 68px inventory size. Palette navy #0e2b5c, warm ivory, muted blue, restrained coral-red, soft apricot and butter yellow. Rounded chunky shapes, large readable details, minimal seams, matte soft material. No thick black outlines, no hard specular gloss, no neon, no gritty photo texture, no extra objects, no platform pedestals. Transparent background and subtle soft contact shadows only.

b.style: OPTION B — COLLECTIBLE CLAY WITH DELICATE LIGHT RIM. Keep clay volume but use a very thin warm ivory edge highlight integrated into the material, never a thick sticker border. Slightly cleaner faceted panels than option A, collectible toy appearance. Base material stays navy and ivory; rarity colors ONLY small cuff bands, piping, badge inset or narrow stripe: balaclava and gloves use muted Rare blue; cap and boots use muted Epic lavender; stopwatch and helmet use soft Legendary gold. No colored background or badge text. Consistent soft top-left lighting, a narrow cream rim rather than neon glow.
